content.short: Fungify is a non-custodial NFT peer-to-contract marketplace and lending protocol.
content.description: Fungify is a peer-to-pool NFT marketplace and lending protocol that lets users place their NFTs into shared pools in exchange for pTokens. A pToken represents a claim to a CNFT within the pool and can be redeemed for the CNFT contained in the same pool, or traded on open markets. These features enable participation in CNFT projects through pooled assets and tokenized claims. Fungify makes it easy for anyone to set up a CNFT-CFT pool for their CNFT project, or release their project through the platform.
